discription: A warm, evolving pad sound using two slightly detuned pulse waves and a resonant low-pass filter modulated by a slow LFO.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000, pulseWidth=0.5, detune=0.005; var sig, env, lfo; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.5, 2.0, 0.7, 4.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Pulse.ar(freq * (1 + detune), pulseWidth) + Pulse.ar(freq * (1 - detune), pulseWidth); lfo = SinOsc.kr(0.1).range(0.5, 1.5); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff * lfo, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
